p.src: 1  Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

en: Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
u.src: 1  Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

p.src: 2  Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

en: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
u.src: 2  Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

p.src: 3  Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

en: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
u.src: 3  Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

p.src: 4  Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
u.src: 4  Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

p.src: 5  For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

en: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
u.src: 5  For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
